title: AI Chatbot, Lead Capture, Mailchimp & n8n Automation
description: Built an end-to-end automation system using n8n, Tawk AI, WooCommerce, Mailchimp, WordPress, and Google Workspace. Optimized the AI chatbot for faster responses, implemented reliable lead capture with Mailchimp integration, automated inquiry acknowledgements and AI email drafting, and designed a scalable abandoned cart recovery workflow using n8n Data Tables instead of Wait nodes. Delivered a fast, reliable solution that streamlined customer support, lead management, and email automation.

title: Shopify & Zoho Clinical Workflow Automation
description: Built an end-to-end Shopify + Zoho system to automate OTC applications, prescription requests, clinical reviews, prescription signing, and product access. Integrated Shopify, Zoho CRM, Forms, Writer, and Sign with automated doctor workflows, PDF generation, notifications, form prefilling, and further-information processes. 90% of the automation and business logic was developed using Zoho Deluge scripting, including Shopify tag-based access using OTC and Open Prescription tags.

type: CRM & Automation Developer | Brevo CRM, Zapier
title: Brevo CRM Customer Journey & Multi-Platform Automation
description: Built an end-to-end customer journey connecting Perspective.io, ThriveCart, and Brevo CRM using Zapier. Automated the flow from funnel entry and course purchase through buyer and non-buyer follow-ups. Integrated ThriveCart purchasing data with Brevo and configured automated follow-up sequences to engage customers based on their purchase status, creating a streamlined customer journey with minimal manual work.

title: Workiz Job Automation & Google Sheets Integration
description: Built an automated Workiz-to-Google Sheets integration using Make.com to capture newly created jobs and send their data to Google Sheets according to the client’s requirements. Since Make.com did not provide an instant trigger for newly created Workiz jobs, implemented a custom webhook-based trigger using Workiz automation. This enabled real-time job data transmission to Make.com and automated record creation in Google Sheets whenever a new job was created.
